doors.truthFlag: The Events Calendar list view: every upcoming date as a card (title, weekday date, poster, /event/<slug>/ link); the page links the Tribe REST route
doors.note: WordPress + The Events Calendar (tribe-events markup, 370 class hits). The home page shows the same cards in a carousel.

Every published date on one page. Each row: id, title (HTML entities), description (HTML), start_date/end_date as local wall clock with timezone America/New_York, url (/event/<slug>/), image.url (the poster), empty venue[] and organizer[], empty cost. Three rows share one slug with a date suffix (the Vault's three nights). An unbounded read (no dates) on 2026-10-30 answered 22, the three extra being Oct 29 dates already past.

doors.truthFlag: 17 VEVENTs — the Tribe iCal export caps the list view's page
doors.note: A second door with the same rows minus two; the REST route is the configured reader's door because it states its own completeness (total_pages).

recon.notes: Recon 2026-10-30 (four reads, 4 s apart: robots, /events/, the REST route twice — unbounded and windowed). The site publishes exactly the Spooky Bear weekend ahead (Oct 30 – Nov 1, 2026): the Vault on three nights, two seatings each of the HalloQueen Burner Brunch (Fri), Crown Ghouls drag brunch (Sat) and Tryster Act brunch (Sun), Witch Perfect on two nights, Motherdisco, Death Becomes Them, Sirens, Mixtape, Rest in Piano, Drop Dead to the Grave, Scarlett Strauss' Booo-b Bash and the weekly SHOWTUNES. Nothing is dated after Nov 1 (the season's end). Before this source, Fat Slut, Motherdisco, Death Becomes Them and Witch Perfect reached the calendar only as Gathr rows pointing at tryst.events ticket pages.

coverage.basis: The REST feed answers total 19 / total_pages 1 for the window from today; the /events/ list page shows the same 19 cards; the iCal export carries 17 of them. All singles (two seatings of one brunch are two Event rows with their own ids; the Vault's three nights are three dated rows under one slug).
